_comment: Guided puzzle solutions for FINAL FANTASY VI (src/core/field/puzzle_guide.cpp). Map ids are the map master's (tools/mapdump/ff6_master/map.txt); cells are baked tile coordinates, one row above the dumps' ty for tile objects since the 2026-10-11 bottom-edge fix in bake_maps.py (tools/mapdump/ff6_objects.jsonl). Authored 2026-10-10 from the dumps' developer labels and the games' known answers; not yet tested in game. Still to author (OPEN_ISSUES.md): Phoenix Cave and Kefka's Tower switch sets, the Cave to the Sealed Gate's moving islands, Owzer's second painting, the Opera House levers, the Phantom Train and Dreamscape levers.

puzzles._about: Zozo: the clock in the weapon shop building (map 387, (125,46)) is set to 6:10:50; the wall at (10,19) in the inn (map 386) then opens.
Darill's Tomb B2: examining the stone at (28,43) on map 458 makes a door appear (the passage at (28,40)); the stone at (76,13) on map 463 does the same there.
Ancient Castle: the hidden switch at (34,15) on map 517 makes the hidden stairs appear in the queen's room on map 518 (the stair cells around (31..34,67)).
Cultists' Tower: the hidden switch at (9,9) on map 478 makes the door appear.
Owzer's Mansion: the flower painting at (111,18) on map 442 is examined (a battle follows).
